question_put_to_a_human: WHAT ARE CHAPTERS 715 THROUGH 724 ABOUT, IN ONE SENTENCE? PUT TO A HUMAN IN ONE SENTENCE BEFORE THIS FILE WAS WRITTEN. NO HUMAN ANSWERED. NO HUMAN HAS ANSWERED THE SAME QUESTION FOR 695-704 OR FOR 685-694. THE FAMILY BELOW IS THEREFORE A WRITER'S AND IS FLAGGED AS ONE, IN THE SAME WORDS 0042 THROUGH 0052 FLAGGED THEIRS, AND ON THE PROMPT'S OWN COUNT IT IS THE ELEVENTH FAMILY SPENT BY A WRITER AND NONE BY A HUMAN. NO WRITER MAY ANSWER THAT QUESTION FOR A HUMAN IN 0054 EITHER. IF NO HUMAN ANSWERS IT AGAIN, WRITE A FAMILY ANYWAY, FLAG IT THE SAME WAY, AND PRINT IT AT THE TOP OF THE CONTINUATION 0054 BLOCK.

family.name: THE TELEPHONE THAT RINGS IN THE WRONG HOUSE
family.is_the_twelfth_family_and_the_eleventh_w: ON THE PROMPT'S OWN COUNTING, AND THE COUNTING IS THE PROMPT'S AND NOT OURS.
family.one_sentence: People live with telephones they will not use and numbers they will not ring, a bell sounds in a house where the person it is for does not live, a call reaches a kitchen four doors along and is not put right, and nobody says the line is crossed, because saying it means somebody has to act on it.
family.why_this_and_not_the_water: THE WATER DEVICE OF 0048 IS SPENT AS A SPREAD AND IS NOT RE-SPREAD. A TAP THAT DRIPS AND A BOWL THAT FILLS MAY NOT APPEAR AS THE SUBJECT OF ANY CHAPTER OF 715-724. THE SILL IS WIPED IN 0710 AND NOT AGAIN. THE JUG LID AND THE TAPED CORNER IN 0713 ARE NOT REPEATED. WHERE WATER IS MENTIONED IT IS A TAP SHUTTING TRUE OR A STONE. THE BOWL IS EMPTYED TWICE AND IS NOT THE SUBJECT OF ANY CHAPTER HERE.
family.test_against_595_604: IT CANNOT BE SUMMED AS SOMEONE DID A SMALL THING AND IT WENT NOWHERE. THE THING IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS IS NOT SMALL AND IT DOES NOT GO NOWHERE. A CALL ARRIVES SOMEWHERE IT WAS NOT MEANT TO GO, AND A RINGING GOES ON IN AN EMPTY BUILDING AND A STRANGER'S BUSINESS IS HEARD IN THE WRONG KITCHEN, AND NOBODY CAN PUT ANY OF IT BACK WHERE IT STARTED.
family.test_against_605_614: IT CANNOT BE SUMMED AS SOMEBODY CARRIED A THING THEY COULD NOT PUT DOWN. NOBODY CARRIES ANYTHING IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS. A TELEPHONE IS UNSCREWED OFF A WALL AND PUT DOWN IN A LOCK-UP, WHICH IS THE OPPOSITE OF CARRYING, AND THE WOMAN WHO DID IT DRIVES HOME THE SAME EVENING.
family.test_against_615_624: IT CANNOT BE SUMMED AS SOMEBODY WAS TOLD A THING THEY COULD NOT PLACE. WHAT GOES ON A TELEPHONE IS NEVER PLACED BY THE PERSON WHO HEARS IT, IT IS PLACED BY A STRANGER WHO HAS RUNG A WRONG NUMBER, AND THE PERSON WHO HEARS IT IS NOT TOLD A THING SO MUCH AS HEARD SOMEBODY ELSE'S BUSINESS.
family.test_against_625_634: IT CANNOT BE SUMMED AS SOMEONE DECIDED SOMETHING AND WAS ASKED WHY AND GAVE A REASON. IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS NINE PEOPLE ARE ASKED WHY THEY DID NOT PICK A TELEPHONE UP AND EIGHT OF THEM GIVE NO REASON AND THE NINTH SAYS ONE WORD THAT IS NOT TRUE.
family.test_against_635_644: IT CANNOT BE SUMMED AS SOMEBODY BROUGHT A THING TO A PERSON AND SOMEBODY ELSE BROUGHT ANOTHER AND THE PERSON HAD TO LIE ABOUT IT. NOTHING IS BROUGHT TO ANYBODY. NOBODY LIES TO ANYBODY'S FACE. THE ONLY FALSE WORD SPOKEN IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS IS ONE WORD SPOKEN DOWN A LINE TO A STRANGER BY A WOMAN WHO THINKS SHE IS HELPING.
family.test_against_645_654: IT CANNOT BE SUMMED AS A WOMAN WROTE THINGS DOWN AND THE PAPER WENT OUT OF HER HOUSE. NOT ONE WORD IS WRITTEN DOWN IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS BY ANY OF THE SIX. THE SCRAP OF SCRIBING CARD WITH TWELVE ON ONE SIDE STAYS IN A POCKET. THE THREE-LINE PAPER COMES OUT OF A DRAWER AND GOES BACK ONTO A TABLE AND IS READ BY NOBODY AND LEAVES NO HOUSE. NOTHING WRITTEN GOES ANYWHERE.
family.test_against_655_664: IT CANNOT BE SUMMED AS A BRUSH NAMED IN A KITCHEN CARRIED BY THREE PEOPLE WHO NEVER MEET AND ENDS ON A PASSAGE FLOOR. THE BRUSH IS ON THE PASSAGE FLOOR AT NUMBER TWELVE AND ONLY THERE AND IS STEPPED OVER ONCE, IN 0717, ON THE WAY TO A TELEPHONE, AND IS NOT PICKED UP AND IS NOT THE DEVICE.
family.test_against_665_674: IT CANNOT BE SUMMED AS A ROOM SHE WILL NOT SIT IN AND A GATE SHE WILL NOT SHUT. THE FRONT ROOM IS ENTERED TWICE IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS AND SHE DOES NOT SIT IN IT AND DOES NOT SIT DOWN IN IT. THE GATE STANDS BACK AGAINST THE COAL SHED WALL WHERE IT HAS STOOD SINCE THE FIRST OF SEPTEMBER AND IS NOT THE DEVICE. THE ROOM IS THE PLACE THE TELEPHONE AND THE MACHINE LIVE, WHICH IS A DIFFERENT REASON FROM A COLD FIRE AND A SIXTY-WATT BULB.
family.test_against_675_684: IT CANNOT BE SUMMED AS A PARCEL SHE CANNOT ASK ABOUT GOES ROUND THE BOROUGH AND CAME BACK WITH A SECOND ADDRESS ON IT. NO PARCEL AND NO BOX GOES ANYWHERE. THE THREE BOXES OF 0052 ARE UNCHANGED AND UNOPENED. THE ONE NEW OBJECT IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS IS A TELEPHONE AND IT GOES FROM A WALL IN AN EMPTY HOUSE TO A LOCK-UP AND STAYS THERE, AND IT DOES NOT COME BACK WITH ANYTHING ON IT.
family.test_against_685_694: IT CANNOT BE SUMMED AS A STEP LADDER GOES ROUND FOUR HOUSES AND TWO STREETS AND ENDS FOLDED IN A ROOM AND NOBODY ASKS WHOSE IT IS. NO LADDER MOVES IN THESE TEN CHAPTERS. ALL FOUR LADDERS ARE WHERE THEY WERE. THE ONLY LADDER IN 715-724 IS THE SUBJECT OF ONE WORD SPOKEN DOWN A TELEPHONE BY A STRANGER TO A MAN IN HIS EARLY FORTIES AT HIS OWN UNIT IN 0718, WHO SAYS HE HAS NOT GOT ONE AND DOES NOT ASK WHY ANYBODY IS LOOKING, AND HE DOES NOT KNOW OF THE LADDER IN THE FRONT ROOM AT NUMBER TWELVE AND NOBODY EVER TELLS HIM.
family.test_against_695_704: IT CANNOT BE SUMMED AS PEOPLE PUT WORK OFF TO THE SPRING WITHOUT NAMING A DATE. A DATE IS NAMED IN 0717, WHICH IS THE FIRST TIME IN THIS BLOCK THAT ANYBODY NAMES A DAY FOR ANYTHING, AND IT IS NAMED AND THEN NOT USED.
family.test_against_705_714: IT CANNOT BE SUMMED AS PEOPLE LIVE WITH WATER THAT KEEPS COMING AND A BOWL EMPTIED AT FIRST LIGHT AND AT DARK. NOT ONE REPETITION OF THAT APPEARS. THE BOWL IS EMPTIED TWICE AND IS NOT THE SUBJECT, THE BATHROOM IS NOT A ROOM IN THIS BLOCK, AND THE SUBJECT OF ALL TEN CHAPTERS IS A SOUND MADE BY AN INSTRUMENT AND A LINE THAT PUTS IT IN THE WRONG PLACE.
family.the_proof_is_not_a_count: THE PROOF IS THAT A CALL ARRIVES SOMEWHERE IT WAS NOT MEANT TO GO AND STAYS THERE. IT GOES INTO THE FRONT ROOM AT NUMBER TWELVE, WHERE THE MACHINE IS, AND THE PERSON WHO HEARS IT IS NOT THE PERSON IT IS FOR. A TELEPHONE TAKEN OFF A WALL IN AN EMPTY HOUSE ON THE FAR SIDE OF THE RING ROAD IS PLUGGED IN AT A LOCK-UP AND RINGS THERE, IN A BUILDING WHERE NOBODY LIVES. A LADDER IS ASKED FOR BY TELEPHONE AT A UNIT FOUR STREETS FROM THE FRONT ROOM IT IS FOLDED IN. THAT IS THE THING ARRIVING SOMEWHERE IT WAS NOT MEANT TO GO, AND IT IS NOT A COUNT.
family.inversion_against_last_block: THE LAST BLOCK DEVICE STAYED AND FILLED AND A THING WAS EMPTIED TWICE A DAY. THIS BLOCK DEVICE SOUNDS AND IS ANSWERED OR IS NOT ANSWERED, AND A FAULT THAT IS BETWEEN TWO HOUSES IS THE FIRST FAULT IN THIS ACCOUNT THAT CANNOT BE FIXED BY ANYBODY STANDING IN ONE KITCHEN. EVERY OTHER FAULT ON THE PAGE IS INSIDE ONE HOUSE: A DRIPPING TAP, A WEEPING CISTERN, A BOWL, A GATE RUN A QUARTER OF AN INCH OUT, A MISSING FELT EDGE, A SHUT DRAWER, A LAMP, A BOX. THIS ONE RUNS BETWEEN NUMBER NINE, NUMBER TEN AND NUMBER TWELVE AND NOBODY OWNS ANY PART OF IT.

bands.the_late_twenties_man_and_why_he_is_give: HE HAS SAT OUT 675-684, 685-694, 695-704 AND 705-714, FOUR BLOCKS IN THIS COUNT AND FIVE IN THE PROMPT'S OWN COUNT WHICH ADDS ONE MORE. HE IS GIVEN 0716 AND 0722 AND THE REASON IS A JOB ON THE PAGE AND NOT THAT HE IS DUE. HIS JOB IS CANON AND IS 0672 AND 0653. HE IS A MAN IN HIS LATE TWENTIES WHO RUNS A VAN AND A SHOP AND DOES DOORS AND KITCHENS AND A CUPBOARD DOOR THAT IS ABOUT A QUARTER OF AN HOUR, FOUR OR FIVE HOUSES A WEEK, ON THE FAR SIDE OF THE RING ROAD, WITH A TAPE ON HIS BELT AND A SET OF KEYS AND A MOBILE IN HIS POCKET. HE PUT A NEW ELEMENT IN THE HOTPLATE AT NUMBER TWELVE IN JUNE. IN 0716 HE IS ON A GROUND-FLOOR BACK ROOM LIFTING A FLOOR AND IN 0722 HE IS ON A FIRST-FLOOR LANDING IN A DIFFERENT HOUSE WITH A DIFFERENT JOB. HE ANSWERS ONE TELEPHONE IN 0722 AND THAT IS THE WHOLE OF HIM IN THIS BLOCK AND IT COSTS HIM SOMETHING.

cards.0715: A woman in her late forties is in an empty house on the far side of the ring road from first light until dark on Monday the fourth of April and takes a telephone off a hall wall because the room has to be empty, finds two pairs of wire on the back of the plate joined to each other, and says nothing about it to the man with the keys at the lock-up.
cards.0716: A man in his late twenties is in a back room off the ring road from first light until dark on Friday the eighth of April with a floor to lift and a tape on his belt and a set of keys, lets a mobile of his own go eleven times in his pocket because the man who booked it is the only person who can ask him for a second thing, and finds two bells on one line in a house with nobody in it.
cards.0717: A woman of seventy-eight is in her own house at number twelve from first light until dark on Thursday the fourteenth of April and goes into the front room over her own brush because a telephone in there has rung for the first time since before Christmas, answers it, hears a stranger ask for a person who does not live there, and puts the receiver back without saying one word.
cards.0718: A man in his early forties is at his own unit from first light until dark on Monday the eighteenth of April with a run of units a quarter of an inch out over six foot and a scrap of scribing card with twelve on one side in his pocket, and when a woman he does not know rings him and asks whether he has a step ladder he says that he has not got one and does not ask her why she is looking.
cards.0719: A woman in her late fifties is in her own house at number nine from first light until dark on Thursday the twenty-first of April and picks a ringing telephone up in her own hall because her hands are full, and tells a stranger on the other end of it that the number they have rung is this one, and does not know it is not.
cards.0720: A woman in her early thirties is in her own kitchen and yard from first light until dark on Tuesday the twenty-sixth of April and takes the folded paper with three lines on it out of the drawer under the worktop and puts it on the table, and lets a telephone ring while it is lying there, and does not pick it up, and the paper stays on the table at dark.
cards.0721: A woman in her late forties is in a lock-up from first light until dark on Saturday the thirtieth of April and plugs a telephone she took off a wall into a socket to see whether it works, and it works, and it rings, and neither she nor the man with the keys answers it, and she puts it back in the bag and ties the bag.
cards.0722: A man in his late twenties is alone on the first-floor landing of a house off the ring road on Tuesday the third of May with the doors off the frames and his mobile in his pocket, and answers a telephone on the wall because he is the only person in the building, and says hello, and the voice at the other end is not ringing a house in this borough.
cards.0723: A woman of seventy-eight is in her own kitchen and at her own gate on Sunday the eighth of May and tells her sister out loud over the step that there is a telephone in this house that rings for people who does not live here, and when her sister asks her to ring them and tell them she does not answer that either.
cards.0724: A man in his early forties is at his own unit from first light until dark on Thursday the twelfth of May with the oak gates still leaning against the wall behind the bench where he put them, and takes the cover off a telephone on his own wall and looks at two pairs of wire joined to each other and puts the cover back and says nothing to anybody about it.

rules_row: THE --- ROW IS FOUR TO TWELVE ACROSS A CHAPTER AND EVERY RULE FALLS AT A REAL CHANGE OF PLACE, TIME OR TURN. A RULE THAT FALLS BECAUSE A PARAGRAPH ENDED IS A STRIP AND IS NOT A RULE. A RULE THAT IS CUT INSTEAD OF BEING STAGED IS STILL A RULE.
dialogue: REQUIRED IN EVERY CHAPTER BY `AGENTS.md`, WHICH IS CONTROLLER-OWNED AND OUTRANKS THIS FILE. WHAT IS BANNED IS NOT SPEAKING AND IT IS WRITING EVERY LINE AS A REPORT OF A CONVERSATION. MEASURED AS THE WORD SAID, WHICH IS NOT BANNED, AND ALSO AS THE NUMBER OF LINES INSIDE QUOTATION MARKS.
movement: NOTHING IS RESCUED. NOTHING IS RESOLVED BY ARRIVING OR BY ACTING. NOBODY ASKS FOR HANDS. THE LINE STAYS CROSSED AND IS NEVER PUT RIGHT AND IS NEVER EXPLAINED. NOBODY RINGS A FREE NUMBER. NOBODY RINGS THE MAN WHO BUILT THE STOOL. NOBODY RINGS THE MAN ON THE RING ROAD. THE FREEHOLDER DOES NOT ARRIVE. NO ROOT TERM EXPIRES. THE CARD IS NOT PUT IN THE SLOT. THE LADDER IS NOT OPENED OUT AND NO ROOM IS PAINTED AND NO LOCK IS TURNED AND NO BOX IS OPENED AND NO DRAWER WITH LEADS OR SCREWS IN IT IS OPENED. THE DRAWER UNDER THE WORKTOP AT NUMBER TEN IS OPENED TWICE IN TEN CHAPTERS AND WHAT COMES OUT OF IT GOES ONTO A TABLE AND STAYS THERE. NOTHING ARRIVES AND NOTHING IS FIXED.
